This mod is made by analogy with minecraft drops. Each drop adds new items, entities, and blocks. It also has a specific theme.

<details>
<summary>Version 1.0 - Holiday drop </summary>

<details>
<summary>New item:</summary>

### 
- Ginger root
- Ground ginger
- Gingerbread dough
- Gingerbread cookie
- Gift box (white, red, green, blue)
- Reindeer moss

</details>

<details>
<summary>New blocks:</summary>

###
- Ginger plant
- Gingerbread dough
- Gingerbread 
- Ginger barrel
- Reindeer moss
- Reindeer moss carpet
- Reindeer mossy stone bricks
- Reindeer mossy cobblestone 

</details>


<details>
<summary>New entity:</summary>

###
- Nutcracker
- Northern deer

</details>
